item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00136","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C01","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.82,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both orders transfer title in Hawaiian land to the Territory, introduce the conveyance with closely parallel operative language, follow it with an extensive metes-and-bounds description, and make the transfer subject to detailed reservations preserving federal military uses or facilities. C01 is also strong because it transfers title to Hawaii while requiring territorial relocation of federal facilities and utilities, but its conditions-precedent and certification machinery differs materially from the child's immediate transfer. C06 supplies especially close easement-and-relocation machinery, but it restores possession, use, and control rather than transferring title and is less similar overall.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"title to the following-described tract of land ... together with the improvements located thereon, is hereby transferred to the Territory of Hawaii","parent_excerpt":"Title to the following-described tract of land adjoining the Honolulu Airport ... is hereby transferred to the Territory of Hawaii","explanation":"Closely parallel operative conveyance language transfers title to a specifically described Hawaiian tract."},{"child_excerpt":"The transfer of the above-described land shall be subject to the following reservations, terms, and conditions","parent_excerpt":"This transfer is made subject to the following conditions","explanation":"Both place a detailed set of retained federal rights and limitations immediately after the land description."},{"child_excerpt":"A reservation of easements and improvements appurtenant thereto, in favor of the United States ... appurtenant to the remaining lands owned by the United States","parent_excerpt":"The United States of America ... shall have the use of the following-described areas ...
